// census-want: 1
// W02-09 Z4 probe: embed.EmbedRaw started as a goroutine inside the attempt
// — it outlives the lease of the block.
package oai

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/backends"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/dispatch"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/embed"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/llm"
)

func goroutineEmbed(ctx context.Context) {
	llm.WalkChain(ctx, nil, "embed", nil, nil, llm.WalkRules{}, func(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, timeout time.Duration) (dispatch.Usage, bool, error) {
		go embed.EmbedRaw(context.Background(), *b, "m", []string{"x"}, 0)
		return dispatch.Usage{}, false, nil
	})
}
